t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Gnomes come in pairs - depending on the colour it goes to a bright forest or a dark forest - which leads to a certain number of shrooms aim is to gather as many shrooms as possible so to get to the forest with the most shrooms but the number changes regularly- important to try to get x5 multiplier as that will lead to the most amount of mushrooms at the end

vb_textbox.text: Gnomes appear in fixed pairs (positions can vary):- orange and brown- green and pink- red and yellow- blue and purpleeach gnome within pair leads to different forest- orange, green, red, blue -> bright forest with red basket- brown, pink, yellow and purple-> dark forestreach forest with most mushrooms - but number changes constantlyuse information from above regarding link between gnomes and forests to get different forests and track how much mushrooms you can get - always go for forest with most mushrooms
